hook: We got married. **How do we register** it?
hook_q: How do I register my marriage?

slides.title: Hindu marriage? **Your State's rules.**
slides.body: Under the Hindu Marriage Act, each State Government makes rules for entering marriages in a Hindu Marriage Register. So the procedure **depends on your State.**

slides.title: Compulsory? **Depends on your State.**
slides.body: A State can make registration compulsory in all or part of the State. But not registering does not make a Hindu marriage invalid.

slides.title: The register is **evidence.**
slides.body: The Hindu Marriage Register is open for inspection at reasonable times, and it is admissible as evidence of what it records.

slides.title: Special Marriage Act: **who can marry?**
list: Neither of you has a living spouse
Both able to give valid consent
Not within prohibited degrees of relationship

slides.title: Special Marriage Act: **the steps.**
list: Written **notice** to the Marriage Officer where one of you lived 30+ days.
You and **three witnesses** sign a declaration.
Marriage solemnized; a **certificate** is entered and signed.

slides.title: Already married by **ceremony?**
slides.body: A marriage done in another form can also be registered by a Marriage Officer under the Special Marriage Act, if conditions are met, such as living together as husband and wife since.

slides.title: Uttarakhand: **60 days.**
slides.body: Under Uttarakhand's Uniform Civil Code (in force since 27 Jan 2025), marriages after that date, in Uttarakhand or involving an Uttarakhand resident (Scheduled Tribes excluded), must be submitted for registration within 60 days.
slides.ref: UCC Rules, Uttarakhand, 2025 · Rules 1(3), 2, 8(1)(a)(iv); UCC 2024 · Sec 10

sources: Uniform Civil Code, Uttarakhand, 2024 – Section 10, and Uniform Civil Code Rules, Uttarakhand, 2025 – Rules 2, 8 (ucc.uk.gov.in)
caption:
Just married and wondering about registration? Here's how it works. 👇

1️⃣ Hindu marriages: each State makes its own registration rules, so the procedure depends on your State
2️⃣ A State can make registration compulsory, but not registering does not make a Hindu marriage invalid
3️⃣ The marriage register is admissible as evidence, so registering gives you proof
4️⃣ Special Marriage Act: give written notice to the Marriage Officer of a district where one of you lived 30+ days
5️⃣ Objections can be made within 30 days; then you and three witnesses sign, and a certificate is entered
⚠️ Uttarakhand (Scheduled Tribes excluded): under the State's Uniform Civil Code, a marriage must be submitted for registration within 60 days

Source: Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 (Sec 8); Special Marriage Act, 1954 (Sec 4, 5, 6, 7, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16); Uniform Civil Code Rules, Uttarakhand, 2025 (Rule 8)
